text:
Rae-CS: Quick escalation 9NovellaPay needs a brief EU/UK QPS bump and an outbound CIDR allowlist for a partner-facing demo tonight. Renewal touchpoint tomorrow AM.

Eoin-NovellaPay: Demo 2025-06-10 19:00-20:30 UTC. Org: novella-prod. CIDR: 198.51.100.0/24. Workload: short streaming sessions + embeddings. Target peak 1,000 QPS, sustained ~650.

Marta-SRE: We can do a scoped rule. Confirm if they want routing pinned to eu-west-2 only and whether token-cost logs are needed. Also ask for a 10m warmup.

Eoin-NovellaPay: Pin to eu-west-2 only, enable token-cost logging, yes to 10m warmup starting 18:50 UTC.

Rae-CS: Procurement will watch demo closely; please treat as high-priority.

Marta-SRE: Plan: 1) apply allowlist 198.51.100.0/24 to eu-west-2 egress 2) set per-org ceiling 1,200, per-route soft 1,000 for window 3) routing policy: prefer eu-west-2 only 4) enable token traces 5) auto-revoke + verify 20m after.

Marta-SRE: Need an ops ticket for audit. @ops-bot, create TEMP-EU-2801239999 with payload.

ops-bot: TEMP-EU-2801239999 created in queue customer-success. Assigned to marta-sre. SLA 1h.

Marta-SRE: Rule applied -> rule_id=r-eu44b2. Allowlist active, QPS set, routing pinned. Token-cost trace enabled. Warmup scheduled.

Eoin-NovellaPay: Warmup done at 18:50. All good so far, small latency drop noticed but within expectations.

Marta-SRE: Change will auto-revoke at 2025-06-10T20:30:00Z. Verification scheduled 20:50Z.

ops-bot: Reminder posted 15 minutes before start and 5 minutes before warmup.

Marta-SRE: (after) Revoke complete. rule_id=r-eu44b2 removed at 2025-06-10T20:51:10Z. Verification passed, no residual entries. Aggregated token-cost CSV attached to TEMP-EU-2801239999.

Rae-CS: Customer reported demo success and asked for the cost delta. Sending CSV to procurement. Win for renewal.

Eoin-NovellaPay: Thanks everyone, will follow up on PO.

Marta-SRE: Action: I'll add a short runbook and ticket template for region-pinned demo lifts. Rae, please add a note to onboarding about warmup guidance.
